_ghi_chu: Spec Sec11.6 tu khai cot action/trigger cua no la DICH CAN TRA.
Bang duoi la ket qua chay `node src/xuat_catalog.js --liet-ke` ngay
24/09/2026 tren dung cac ban da ghim o `pieces` phia tren.
`co` = ten spec doan DUNG. `khong` = KHONG TON TAI o ban nay.
`thay` = co mot action gan nghia; day la mot THAY THE co review, va
no phai doc duoc trong diff -- spec cam thay im lang.

google-sheets._25_09_dynamic: insert_row/update_row tung BO_QUA vi `values` la PropertyType.DYNAMIC (khong co trong `xuat_catalog.KIEU`). Vong P-C (25/09) them anh xa `DYNAMIC -> 'json'` (nguon: framework `dynamic-prop.ts`, `DynamicPropsValue = Type.Record(Type.String(), DynamicProp)` -- ve day no LA mot JSON object phang). Nguoi soan tu dien object, vd `{"A": "gia tri"}`; khong dung form dong nhu UI Activepieces vi runner cua ta khong chay engine cua ho (spec Sec11.1).
google-sheets.get_rows: khong (gan nhat: get-many-rows / get_next_rows -- CHUA dua len palette)
google-sheets.clear_row: khong (gan nhat: clear-rows / clear_sheet -- CHUA dua len palette)
google-sheets.trigger new_row: khong. Piece nay KHONG co trigger POLLING nao ve dong moi; `google-sheets-new-or-updated-row` la WEBHOOK, ma trigger WEBHOOK cua piece NGOAI pham vi (spec Sec11.4). POLLING duy nhat: new-spreadsheet, new-worksheet

slack.upload_file: khong (gan nhat: uploadFile -- prop FILE, CHUA dua len palette)
slack.trigger poll: khong co: 14/14 trigger cua slack la APP_WEBHOOK

github.trigger poll: khong co: 14/14 trigger cua github la WEBHOOK

telegram-bot.send_media: khong dua len palette vong 1 (prop FILE)

google-drive._ghi_chu: Spec Sec11.6 KHONG khai bang doi chieu cho piece nay (ngoai pham vi vong 1). Mo o vong P-C (25/09), ten lay THANG tu `--liet-ke` tren ban 0.9.2 da ghim, khong doan.
google-drive.actions: 53 action o ban 0.9.2; palette chon 5 cai dat-lai duoc voi credential OAuth2/service-account da co: drive_upload_file, drive_create_folder, drive_list_files, drive_download_file, drive_get_file.
